facts.fact: Nielsen adjusted its measurement parameters for Tubi in June 2026 and was still evaluating the impact of that change in the July 2026 release.
facts.quote: In June 2026, Nielsen adjusted its measurement parameters for Tubi and is currently evaluating the impact of this change.

facts.fact: Nielsen's April 2026 Gauge put Tubi at 2.3% of U.S. TV time, the last confirmed Tubi share cited on this page.
In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, streaming was 49.0% of TV.
In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, YouTube was 14.2% of TV.
In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, Peacock was 2.6% of TV.
In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, cable was 18.7% of TV.
In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, broadcast was 19.5% of TV.
In Nielsen's June 2026 Gauge, streaming's category share was 48.5%.
In Nielsen's June 2026 Gauge, FOX was 7.4% of TV as a media distributor.
In Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge, FOX as a media distributor was 7.8% of TV, up 0.4 points.
facts.quote: Fox as a media distributor. +0.4 points.

facts.fact: Nielsen's May 2026 Gauge put The Roku Channel at 3.1% of total TV and Paramount Streaming at 2.3%, and did not name Tubi.
facts.quote: The Roku Channel at 3.1% of total TV and Paramount Streaming (Paramount+ and Pluto TV combined) at 2.3%

facts.fact: Tubi's CPM in the 2024 Ad Age agency average was $17.95, not a 2026 rate card.
facts.quote: Tubi's row there is $17.95 in that 2024 agency average, not a 2026 rate card.

facts.fact: Adwave's paid media starts at a prepaid daily budget of $30/day across Meta, Google, TikTok, Reddit, web, and TV.
facts.quote: one prepaid daily budget starting at **$30/day**

facts.fact: Nielsen's July 2026 Gauge was released on September 10, 2026.
Nielsen's June 2026 Gauge reported more than 84 billion minutes across FOX and NBCUniversal properties.
facts.quote: Nielsen reported more than 84 billion minutes across FOX and NBCUniversal properties.
